svg.title: File names (F86): the rename plan with reason filters, out-of-date rows, refusals and bulk rename
svg.desc: The plan list under the template card. Panel 1: reason filters with counts, a select-all row, and nine rows: a junk name to rename, an out-of-date name showing the title change, a clash with another video settled by its id, refused rows for a name that would not read back, a clash with an untracked file and a name over 255 bytes, a locked row with Unlock, a held row, and a no-template row; a sticky bar with Clear and Rename 3. Panel 2: the bar's inline confirm. Panel 3: rows after the rename is queued. Panel 4: Plan mode and draft preview bars. Panel 5: the list at 375 px.
svg.text: 1 · Plan in Manual mode, filter All — every reason a row can carry
Names are never truncated: a pair that doesn't fit one line stacks old over new.
3,681 videos · names from your saved templates
3 selected of the 1,241 you can rename

, so this one carries its id.
, which ends {studio} in template 1. It would read back as

A Very Long Title That Keeps Going Well Past What Fits…
The name would be 291 bytes. The limit is 255.
Locked when you renamed it outside Holodex on Oct 12.
Its original is held until Nov 4. It can be renamed after that.
No template fits: it has no title.
2 · Rename asks once, inline in the bar (System activity's confirm pattern)
Rename 1,241 files? You can undo each one from its video page.
3 · After Rename: rows report in place; the run's totals go to System activity
Not renamed: a file took that name before the rename ran.
4 · The bar when nothing can be renamed from here
Plan mode: no checkboxes and no Rename. Draft preview: the plan shows unsaved templates, and Rename waits for Save.
Plan mode: nothing on disk changes. Choose Manual above to rename.
Previewing unsaved templates. Save them to rename.
5 · 375 px: filters scroll sideways in one row; names always stack
Title changed since Holodex named it.
Title changed since Holodex named it.
6 · Landing: saved templates fold to one line; the tab opens on Out of date while it isn't empty
The card stays open while a draft is unsaved or a template has an error. Edit templates ▾ opens it.
